acceptance_criteria: Chain break signatures detected; Exact Break Cell claimed only when location_status is CERTAIN (soft agreement ≥70% with ≥2 patterns).

localization.description: Candidate break bit = consensus of per-pattern first EXPECTED vs ACTUAL mismatch indices from ScanOut; mapped to STIL ScanCells. Exact fields are populated only when location_status is CERTAIN (soft agreement ≥70% and ≥2 patterns); otherwise exact_break_cell is LOCATION_UNCERTAIN and candidate_* fields hold the review localization.
